verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud is a managed service that stores customer data, so whether it offers an AI-training opt-out or a no-training guarantee is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents such a policy, setting, or contractual commitment. The community comment about mandatory telemetry concerns usage reporting, not AI model training, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
